( [ { ( [ The numerator captures how much the model repeats when cued by the ground-truth prefix, so a higher value there means the model is leaning on copying the given text rather than generating novel continuations ] ) } ] ), which runs directly against the goal of minimizing repetition. In other words, as the ratio grows, the ground-truth-conditioned repetition is swelling relative to the self-conditioned baseline, signaling that the model is more prone to regurgitate whatever it is handed. A smaller ratio would be preferable, indicating that repetition stays low (or at least does not spike) when the model is prompted with the ground truth.
